conviction_note: Two-sided print: the company committed on 2026-09-09 to revise its full-year forecast at this release, and its own July Q&A says semiconductor demand runs above budget and the Q1 Faraday-rotator shipment slipped into Q2, so an operating-profit raise is plausible (about a coin flip); against that, the stock has fallen from before the release to the next close on each of its last four prints, and 690.9k margin-long shares sit against about zero margin shorts after a 38% fall since April. Findings sum to 0.0, and the scaled number is (2*0.49-1)*9.0 = -0.18. The two agree that there is no edge on direction while the move size stays large.
bar: Company full-year plan FY2027/2: revenue 9,828m, OP 933m, ordinary 788m, net 597m, unchanged at Q1 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/65210/081220260714592903_tse-qcedjpsm-65210-20260714365210-ixbrl.htm). No H1 plan is disclosed. There is no analyst coverage (IFIS shows no rating or target, https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report_top&bcode=6521) and Shikiho could not be reached. So the market's own number is unsourced and every finding is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is my estimate of the revised full-year OP against the 933m plan.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed shorts are 1.69% from 2 sellers as of 2026-10-14, up 0.06pt (building slightly; baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). The margin balance is lopsided: kabutan shows margin longs of 690.9k shares on 10/09 against 0.0k margin shorts. It is a 制度信用 buy-only name, so 信用倍率 reads '-'. 690.9k is about 6% of the 11.63m shares outstanding and about 5-6 days of volume (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=6521). There are no options and no skew. priced_lean_pct is +0.81, almost all from the short_squeeze component. Today, 10/15 at 10:08 JST, the stock was -6.0% at 3,190 with the Nikkei -3.95% on a US CPI shock. The sealed spot of 3,140 already carries that fall.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-09 the company committed to disclosing a full-year forecast revision with the H1 results on 2026-10-15. The trigger is a 280m extraordinary gain on donated crystal-growth furnaces from Raicol (160m in Q2, 120m in Q3), about +47% of the 597m net plan. The unpriced part is whether OP and revenue are raised too: the 2026-07-16 Q&A says semiconductor revenue beat the Q1 plan with demand 'a tailwind versus budget time', Q1 OP beat plan by about 17m, and Faraday capacity was expanded twice (2026-08-19, then another 841m on 2026-10-14).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stand-alone full-year OP raise of 2026-01-28 (semiconductor demand above plan) sent the stock limit-up, +21.97% on 01-29 and +6.71% on 01-30. Its earlier revisions came at Q3 or as separate notices (24/01/12, 25/01/14, 26/01/28). The last H1-timed upward revision was FY2022/2, on 21/10/14. The 09-09 gain notice itself moved the stock only +2.03% on 09-10.
findings.why_not_priced: The net-profit uplift is public and was bought only +2% on 09-10, so I sized it at a fraction. That part is priced. What is not priced is the operating line. No analyst publishes a number, and the stock trades at 3,140, 38% below its April high and at about 62x the unrevised plan EPS. If the market expected an OP raise, the stock would not sit near its post-April lows into a print it knows carries a revision.
findings.independence: Q1 Q&A, a different document: https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/65210/140120260715594876.pdf (semis above plan, Faraday slip booked in Q2). Capex notice: https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261014550735.pdf (more Faraday capacity, 'impact on FY results under review').

findings.finding: Per the company's 2026-07-16 Q&A, the Faraday-rotator batch that slipped out of Q1 because of a materials delay books in Q2, and new-domain H1 sales are 'solid'. Q2 should therefore swing sharply against last year's Q2 OP of -117m (H1 FY26 OP -189m, while Q1 FY27 alone was +199m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 FY27 '黒字浮上' beat (12:00 release on 2026-07-14) went from 4,175 at the open to a 3,950 close the next day, -5.4%. The FY26 Q2 print (2025-10-15 12:00, '経常9%減益') went from a 1,915 open to a 1,846 close the next day, -3.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The company told the market the slip would land in Q2, so the finding is close to inside what was guided and is sized near zero. What remains unpriced is the size of the semiconductor overshoot in Q2, which nobody publishes.
findings.independence: Shares the Q&A document with finding 1 (counted once there for the guidance read). Kabutan's Q1 table is separate: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6521&b=k202607140008

findings.finding: Supply overhangs the print. Margin longs hold 690.9k shares (about 6% of shares outstanding, about 5-6 days of volume) against about zero margin shorts, mostly bought between 3,300 and 4,500 after the April peak of 5,640. From before the release to the next close, the stock has fallen on each of its last four prints: 2025-10 -3.6%, 2026-01 -2.4%, 2026-04 -15.5%, 2026-07 -5.4%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The four prints above were all sold from before the release to the next close, including the 2026-07 beat. The exception was a stand-alone upward OP revision outside a print (2026-01-28, limit-up).
findings.why_not_priced: The margin balance is public, so this is not hidden information. It is a reaction-function argument: underwater margin longs sell into strength (やれやれ売り), which caps the upside of a good print without being visible in the spot. A kabutan market column of 2026-10-14 told retail to buy 'if it goes up after results', which adds momentum both ways.
findings.independence: Tape from Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6521.T?range=2y&interval=1d). The kabutan column is https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6521&b=n202610141015

findings.finding: Healthcare (PET scintillator crystals) faces rising raw-material costs, and the company is renegotiating trading terms with its customer. This is a margin risk to whatever H1 and full-year OP the release shows.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print where healthcare margin was the stated driver was found.
findings.why_not_priced: It sits in a Q&A memo with no number attached. Healthcare is a minority segment (about 15% of FY2025 sales), so I sized it net of the semiconductor and new-domain lines, which point the other way.
findings.independence: Shares the Q&A document with findings 1 and 2. No other source.

outside_window.finding: The new Faraday-rotator line (841m, plant 6) starts in H2 FY2027/2. The extra capacity and its depreciation reach the P&L after this window.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: yes, committed in the 2026-09-09 notice. Net profit rises by up to the 280m gain (public); OP is the unknown, and my estimate is a modest raise or hold, about +4% on 933m. Returns: none expected (no dividend, no buyback history). New-year guide: not applicable (H1 print). Quarter versus its own 進捗率: Q1 OP was 21% of the FY plan against negative Q1s in the two prior years, so the business is less Q4-heavy this year and H1 OP should be clearly positive against -189m last year.

baseline_tension: Mixed. The baseline's lean (+0.81, from a small disclosed short) and the flat 20-day run-up are weakly positive; my fundamentals lean positive (a committed revision, semis above plan); positioning and the reaction function lean negative (a crowded margin long, four prints sold in a row). The strongest positive the release could carry is a full-year OP raise on top of the forced net-profit revision. I looked for it and put it at about a coin flip. Shareholder returns are absent.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on data the market already has): the positioning finding rests on a public margin balance and public reaction history, so I trimmed it from -2.0 to -1.5 and moved p_up from 48 to 49. Applied once to each measurement.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): I had already looked for the strongest positive (the committed forecast revision with a possible OP raise), so nothing more moved.
Open question 4 (a run-in as a short signal): the 5-day run-up here is negative (-8.99%), so it does not apply; no change.
